items.source_en:
This site is perfectly suited to human habitation. Supervisors should have no trouble getting the outpost set up and starting excavation. Once digging starts, keep an eye out for fossils! There appears to be abundant alien life on this planet. I wouldn't be surprised if you found them in spades.

I'd advise against drenching the ground for excavation purposes, since the stone below the site is prone to erosion. You should also expect regular visits from the local geophagic creatures. They seem to enjoy grazing in the area. In my experience so far, they're harmless.

In all, this should be an easy and enjoyable job. Best of luck to you! 

Elliot

PROPERTY OF SIX SISTERS. GEOLOGICAL SURVEY DATA IS PROPRIETARY AND CONFIDENTIAL
